text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while searching for a good spot
off-campus to do some training――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Lord Golshi has arrived!! Ta-daaan!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tea needs snacks! Pacific saury needs grated radish!
And a Demon King Castle needs a Final Dungeon!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You can't separate iconic combos like these! Am I right, brother?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I get your struggle. "Life is a maze," as a great,
wise Lord Golshi once said back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No need to fret, leave it to me!
I'll whip up the ultimate dungeon for ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am the Uma King Golshi!
I'm gonna be the Dungeon King!! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why a dungeon, exactly?
Dragged along without a clue, the destination we arrived at was――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, what a glorious city of water!
Truly worthy of falling under my grand dominion!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Should our dungeon be underwater then?!
Golshi-chan is so torn!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the sea, you know~ It's Sei-chan's secret fishing spot.
Though I guess it's not a secret anymore...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho, a fishing horse-person. Want me to recruit ya into my party?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but no thanks~ What's this about a dungeon anyway?
Building a theme park or something~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: 'Cause the weather's nice!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... makes total sense.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's just the usual with her.
If you think about it too hard, you've already lost~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! This spot's a dungeon candidate too!
Man, the Uma King is one busy overlord... Next, next!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, I'll stand guard here~
Have a safe trip, Lord Uma King~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When you think dungeon,
you gotta have an arena for the final boss battle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be a place where your voice echoes for no good reason!
YAHOOO!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>, Golshi-san! You're being far too noisy!
We are in the middle of training, so please do not disturb—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y-You're...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hold on, I'm figuring out your role in the cast right now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Babbling nonsense as always... In any case,
this is hardly a place for fooling around.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, look at that raw fighting spirit bared for all to see.
Alright, wanna throw down in a boss battle?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship looked ready to challenge King Halo
to a sumo match or a pro wrestling brawl on the spot.
choice_data_list: Lord Uma King, you cannot fight here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mm. It is too small to build a castle here... Wait a second.
Can't we at least use it for training?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That is precisely what I have been telling you all along!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we toured all over the academy
searching for dungeon candidates, but in the end—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can't decide, man. Every single spot
is just too good to pass up. Ah, what a beautiful world...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But without a dungeon, I can't build a castle either.
...Guh, what am I supposed to do?!
choice_data_list: Why not just put castles everywhere...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What... did you say...?! 
You're saying we should make it a mobile fortress?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's gotta transform... I see, bad freakin' ass!
Then it definitely needs to fire beam cannons and fly through the sky!
choice_data_list: No, that's not really what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that idea off your hands!
Leave the piloting to me... the genius Lady Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold Ship's eyes sparkled
as she envisioned her dream-filled mobile fortress.
